ValidationRule.description: This Water Lab Test Required record is read-only and can only be modified by the Salesforce API Only System Integrations or System Administrator profiles. Exception: Facility cascade from an orphan requisition (PHOCSManageOrphanLabRequisitions).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterLabTestRequired", CreatedBy.Profile.Name = "Salesforce API Only System Integrations", $Profile.Name <> "Salesforce API Only System Integrations", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT(AND( $Permission.PHOCSManageOrphanLabRequisitions, ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(FacilityName__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(FacilityName__c)) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Lab Result is created by integration and cannot be edited.
